name: Trial sequence — any niche (the client's offer to the client's prospects)
source: Structure of Sequence T (The 30-Day Trial, Section 10): plain text, no links in email 1, one reply CTA, four touches. Wording is new, written for the client's own offer; the client reviews it on the approval page and the owner edits it in Mission Control on request.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, a quick follow-up on my note. If {niche} is on your list this year, I'm happy to share what we see working for {ICP}.

Is a short call worth it?

touches.subject: {Company} and {niche}

touches.body:
{FirstName}, I don't want to crowd your inbox, so this is my last note. If this becomes a priority for {Company} later, just reply and I'll pick it up.

Should I close the file for now?
